learning_outcomes.text: Get acquainted with working liquids and gases, hydraulic and pneumatic machines, hydraulic elements, their connection in a hydraulic system of motion and computating such kind of systems.
Gain knowledge about construction, service and joint function of basic and auxiliary elements, so that students can computate and connect them into pneumo systems.

syllabus_topics: Working liquids, hydro motion and their application in mechanical engineering-structure, characteristics, function, choice of pumps and hydro motors, compressors and pneumatic motors.
Parameters of hydro and pneumatic motions.
Reduce valve – structure, function and characteristics.
Accessory elements – seals, tanks, filters, hydraulic accumulators.
Assemble of hydraulic and pneumatic devices.
Tubes for hydro and pneumatic motions.
Scheme of connecting hydro and pneumomotors –position, synchronization and sequence of action.
Control and stabilization of the velocity of hydro and pneumomotors.
Hydraulic reinforcements and proportional devices –kinds, function characteristics, application.
Basic principles of hydraulic and pneumosystems design.
teaching_methods: Lectures (traditional way showing slides and other visual aids)
assessment_rules: The exam is both written and oral. Students work out a report for each laboratory class.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
